name: The Setai
insider_take: Where Art Deco glamour meets Asian zen philosophy on Miami's most coveted stretch of sand.
whats_special: The Setai features three distinct temperature-controlled pools in a stunning courtyard design, plus it's one of the few hotels where you can enjoy both oceanfront luxury and the vibrant South Beach nightlife. The property seamlessly blends 1930s Art Deco architecture with contemporary Asian influences, creating Miami's most sophisticated beachfront sanctuary.
pro_tip: Book a suite on floors 35+ for breathtaking panoramic views of both Biscayne Bay and the Atlantic Ocean - you'll catch stunning sunrises over the ocean and spectacular sunsets over the city skyline.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature afternoon tea service in the courtyard, and be sure to experience the rooftop bar at sunset. Take a stroll down Ocean Drive to see the world's largest collection of Art Deco buildings, all within walking distance of your oceanfront oasis.
pros: Sophisticated Art Deco design with Asian-inspired minimalist interiors
Three temperature-controlled infinity pools overlooking the Atlantic Ocean
Prime South Beach location with direct beach access and proximity to nightlife
Spacious suites and penthouses with ocean views and luxury amenities
cons: Minimalist aesthetic may feel austere to some guests
